node.title: Re^4: Unescaped left brace in regex
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Although I suspect this might be a legacy system, I think you might want to invest some time looking into a templating engine, such as [mod://Template], because generating HTML like this can be fairly brittle. Although it'd be a bigger change, you could also think about replacing [mod://CGI].pm with a framework that has templating built in, such as [mod://Mojolicious] (see also [id://1182902]).
